secondary_ocr.Text: DAMN! THEY TALINTED ME INTO A TRAP AND I RAN RIGHT AT IT!
BUT WHY WOULD THE DARK KNIGHTS SEND ME BACK--
SHH...I KNOW. I KNOW. I WON'T LET ANOTHER MOMENT PASS WITHOUT Y
I-I'M SORRY, IRIS-FOR JUDGING YOU LIKE I DID.

RED DEATH...
HIS POWERS
MADE YOU SO
BRITTLE...BE
CAREFUL.

I KEEP
HOPING I'LL
WAKE UP FROM THIS
NIGHTMARE AND
FIND YOU SLEEPING
NEXT TO ME LIKE
BEFORE...
I'VE MISSED YOU SO MUCH, BARRY-I'M SORRY I KILLED THAWNE--
I'LL GET YOU AND WALLY OUT OF CENTRAL CITY, I'LL SAVE--
